description: Compal RXM-G1 (module SG500M2-X, also sold as VOS 5G) in its debug/QMI composition (AT+USBCOMP=debug on the prototype). It reports the same USB ID 1e2d:00b7 as the Foxconn T99W175 / Thales MV31, whose AT recipes it does not share: no AT signal commands (AT+CSQ, AT^TEMP?, AT^DEBUG? come back empty), so no Foxconn radio dialect. Told apart by ModemManager's model, which wins over the Foxconn profile's ID-only match. ModemManager only: plain QMI in netifd did not open its services in the field. No reset levels declared until a bench: an underpowered hub gave ttys without a data function, and resets do not cure that. Reference only, no bench of ours: docs/modem-zoo/modems/compal-rxm-g1.md, another modem manager 3.5.8 (its Compal identity check, the 1e2d:00b7 header); profiles audit 2026-10-19

recovery.source: radio through ModemManager only; a power-starved hub (ttys, no data function) is not cured by resets (Modem Zoo compal-rxm-g1)
